title: SmarterMail 高危漏洞链公开：一封恶意邮件可拿下服务器 SYSTEM 权限

table_fields.漏洞名称: SmarterMail 存储型 XSS、令牌权限提升及远程代码执行漏洞链
table_fields.漏洞类型: 代码注入 跨站脚本 会话失效不足

sections.intro_text: 安全研究团队 安全研究团队 2026-10-13 16:22 SmarterMail 披露三项可组合利用的安全漏洞，涉及远程代码执行（CVE-2026-104082，CVSS 3.1：7.2）、存储型跨站脚本（CVE-2026-104083，6.1）及会话权限提升（CVE-2026-104084，8.8）。公开研究展示了一条由恶意日历邮件触发跨站脚本、窃取管理员会话令牌、再借助管理功能实现系统级代码执行的攻击链。 **利用前置条件：** - 攻击者能够通过网络访问目标服务并发送恶意邮件 - 目标用户通过 SmarterMail Web 邮箱打开恶意日历邀请邮件，触发存储型 XSS - 需要受害者浏览器中同时存在一个普通邮箱账户会话与SysAdmin账户会话（令牌共存于共享localStorage）或者投递会被反垃圾引擎判为垃圾的恶意邮件使其进入隔离区，由系统管理员在管理界面打开该邮件时触发 **目前360图龙锋 · 漏洞挖掘智能体已成功复现该漏洞。** 本文包含完整影响范围、正式修复方案、技术原理与复现细节。 **漏洞影响范围** 受影响版本范围： SmarterMail Build ＜ 9777 **修复建议** **正式防护方案** 将 SmarterMail 升级至 Build 9777 或更高版本 **漏洞描述** 近日，安全研究人员披露了 SmarterMail 中存在的三个安全漏洞，分别为远程代码执行漏洞（CVE-2026-104082）、存储型跨站脚本漏洞（CVE-2026-104083）及权限提升漏洞（CVE-2026-104084）。三个漏洞可组合形成完整攻击链，使未经身份认证的远程攻击者在满足特定条件时获得服务器 SYSTEM 权限。 其中，**CVE-2026-104083** 源于邮件 HTML 内容过滤机制与浏览器解析行为存在差异。攻击者可通过构造恶意日历邀请邮件，在管理员查看邮件时触发跨站脚本，窃取管理会话令牌。 **CVE-2026-104084** 则涉及会话权限校验缺陷，攻击者可利用未及时失效的高权限令牌维持管理访问。 获得系统管理员权限后，攻击者可进一步利用**CVE-2026-104082** ，通过邮件域存储路径与脚本执行目录之间的校验缺陷，绕过原有安全限制，最终以 SmarterMail 服务账户权限执行任意系统命令。在服务以 SYSTEM 权限运行的环境中，可能导致服务器被完全控制。 **漏洞复现** 安全研究团队依托图龙锋漏洞挖掘智能体已成功复现 CVE-2026-104082、CVE-2026-104083、CVE-2026-104084 漏洞链。研究人员在获取管理会话后完成脚本上传与挂载利用，最终使目标主机回连测试端，并成功取得 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM 权限，验证了远程代码执行危害。 SmarterMail 存储型 XSS、令牌权限提升及远程代码执行漏洞链复现 **产品侧支持情况** **360安全智能体：** 支持该漏洞攻击的智能分析**。** **360测绘云 Quake** ：默认支持该产品的指纹识别。 **360高级持续性威胁预警系统** ：预计 2026年10月14日发布规则更新包，支持该漏洞利用行为的检测。 **360资产与漏洞检测管理系统** ：预计 2026年10月14日发布规则更新包，支持该漏洞利用行为的检测。 **本地安全大脑** ：默认支持该漏洞的PoC检测。 **时间线** 2026年10月13日，安全研究团队发布本安全风险通告。

reference_materials.content: pre-auth rce in smartermail (CVE-2026-104082, CVE-2026-104083, CVE-2026-104084) blog.evan.lat dark main site @ evan.lat . pgp for sensitive stuff: here . corporate friendly version: here pre-auth rce in smartermail (CVE-2026-104082, CVE-2026-104083, CVE-2026-104084) 2026-08-20 SUMMARY: multiple vulns and misconfigurations in smartermail can be chained to achieve remote code execution as nt authority\system; alongside the ability to exfil stuff en masse. thisd is very hastily written; ill add more soon https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-104082 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-104083 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-104084 smartermail wtf is it if you havent heard of smartermail; it is a widely used ms exchange/big groupware alternative used by large enterprises and orgs. for example, raytheon (often makes missiles), fujitsu (often takes photos of missiles), govmails in the middle east (often (at least recently) gets hit by missiles), shinjiru (lol), gigabit hosting, lots of hosting providers (i.e. if you can find a vuln in this you can get ia to a bunch of companies relying on these providers aswell), saas contractors for large f500 companies, M3 USA, lockheed martin, and more. as a result, a lot of people try to breach these instances, and over time there were pretty large lapses in smartermail’s security (e.g. preauth rce) that got abused and burnt immediately (see: smartermail on kev catalog). over time, smartermail heavily tightened up a bunch of stuff, including getting rid of any weird sinks (e.g. an rce sink on admin that runs as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM), deserialization sinks, etc. a pretty commendable job notably. smartermail basics just some basics on how smartermail works: privs there are only 2 main roles that are interesting, sysadmins and domain admins. sysadmins control a single smartermail instance. a single smartermail instance can hold multiple domains. a domain admin is an admin within said domain (huge). sysadmins can do many things, such as creating domains (!!), inspecting spam mail/quarantined mail, mount volumes (!!), view plaintext passwords (all passwords in smartermail are plaintext since they assume that they’re autogenerated i think), impersonate users, etc. domain admins can impersonate users and delete users withi ntheir domain and thats about it lol domains they are just folders on the smartermail box for conveniences sake lol sessions users have an accessToken and a refreshToken. both of these are in localstorage (lol). you can have multiple accesstokens, which is common if you are a sysadmin and you’re an employee. ok thats all you need to know getting smartermail getting the src was easy; just rip it from the docker image. we can then drag the main MailService and SmarterMail.Standard dlls on a decompiler of choice. going through the laundry list of sinks and footguns in c# (e.g. BinaryFormatter) it became pretty obvious that most trivial sinks were out of the question. aside from some preauth surfaces that were interesting (and may be explored in the future idk) anything as easy as the prior vulns for smartermail are pretty much gone lol ok wtf now since its an email service, one of the more devastating vulns we can try to look for are xss sinks. obv with an xss sink we can circumvent auth entirely and hit any authed sink. an even better xss sink would be one that simply requires rendering the email itself. looking for this i landed on this obf stub: SmarterMail.Standard.Utilities.Web.丼.丁 : // yes they added code obfuscation; as you can tell it wasnt really super helpful in curtailing analysis private static bool 丂 ( HtmlNode node , ... ) { string tag = node . payload.object_desc: SmarterMail 是由 SmarterTools 开发的企业级邮件服务器软件，主要用于提供电子邮件收发服务，支持 SMTP、POP3、IMAP 等标准邮件协议，并附带 Webmail 界面、日历协作和即时通讯等功能。该组件适用于各类组织构建自有邮件系统，满足内部通信与协作需求。
payload.vulner_type: 代码注入 跨站脚本攻击会话令牌权限提升
payload.pre_condition: 攻击者需具备网络访问能力以发送恶意邮件；目标用户需通过 Web 界面打开特制邮件；受害者浏览器需同时维护普通用户与系统管理员会话
payload.hazard_level: 未经身份认证的远程攻击者在满足特定条件下可获取服务器 SYSTEM 权限，导致邮件系统完全失陷
payload.vulner_desc: SmarterMail 的邮件 HTML 内容过滤机制与主流浏览器解析行为存在差异，攻击者可通过构造恶意日历邀请邮件在邮件内容中注入脚本代码；配合会话令牌未及时失效的权限校验缺陷，攻击者可窃取管理员会话令牌并维持高权限访问；进一步利用邮件域存储路径与脚本执行目录之间的校验缺陷，可绕过安全限制以 SmarterMail 服务账户权限执行任意系统命令。在服务以 SYSTEM 权限运行的环境中，上述漏洞可串联形成完整攻击链，导致未经身份认证的远程攻击者获得服务器完全控制权。
